statement: Every odd-primary and prime-to-two abelian section of the arithmetic plus quartic, with evaluated elliptic factors, actual toric norm projection and every fibre; all rational abelian pushouts are also evaluated.

notes: The arithmetic origin is constructed by an actual four-coset average. The compact comparison is Phi Psi=Psi Phi=[4], and the generalized-Jacobian comparison uses the unique j with pj=[4]. Each elliptic factor is R via the maximal divisible Weil–Chatelet group, with a fixed coordinate isomorphism and inverse Kummer map. The result computes the specified abelian coefficient targets and does not assert lifting to an odd nonabelian extension. Integral targets retaining the two-primary abelian quotient remain empty by E.18. The complete copied-source reconstruction agrees with every retained mathematical output; there are no comparison exclusions.
